knowledge:
- key_parameters: expMethod=The 5'-profiling protocol used, such as 'MAPCap', 'RAMPAGE', or 'CAGE' ;; idxList=A vector of sample index barcodes used for de-multiplexing ;; sampleNames=A vector of sample names corresponding to the barcodes ;; max_mismatch=Maximum allowed mismatches in barcode matching during de-multiplexing (default is 1) ;; keepPairs=Logical indicating whether to keep both reads of a pair during PCR duplicate filtering (default is FALSE, which filters R2 and secondary alignments) ;; groups=A vector defining experimental groups/conditions for replicates ;; normalization=Normalization method for differential expression, such as 'windowTMM' or NULL if using external spike-ins ;; normFactors=External normalization factors (e.g., from spike-ins) to be passed to fitDiffTSS
- alternatives: Quality trimming can be performed outside R using standard tools like cutadapt or trimgalore before creating the CapSet object ;; Demultiplexing, mapping, and PCR duplicate removal can be performed outside R (e.g., using UMItools for de-duplication), and the CapSet object can be initialized directly from the resulting BAM files ;; Rsubread is used for mapping via mapCaps, but Windows users must map files using an external tool as Rsubread is not available on Windows
- when_to_use: Use this package when analyzing multiplexed, paired-end 5'-profiling transcriptomics data (with or without biological replicates) to identify high-resolution transcription start sites and analyze their differential expression across conditions.
- pitfalls: Rsubread (and thus mapCaps) is not supported on Windows ;; Post-mapping de-multiplexing on BAM files is only recommended when sequencing depth is low (below 10 million reads) ;; Running filterDuplicates with keepPairs = TRUE takes significantly longer, and only the first mate is considered for downstream TSS detection ;; If underlying files are moved or deleted, the sample information must be manually reset using sampleInfo(cs) <- si

workflows.name: end_to_end_tss_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform end-to-end TSS detection and differential expression analysis starting from raw multiplexed paired-end FASTQ files.
input: reference_genome.fa (Reference genome FASTA file for indexing)
workflows.stages: 1. Create a CapSet object with raw FASTQ files and sample barcodes using newCapSet ;; 2. De-multiplex the FASTQ files using demultiplexFASTQ ;; 3. Build a subread index using Rsubread::buildindex ;; 4. Map the de-multiplexed FASTQ files using mapCaps ;; 5. Filter PCR duplicates using filterDuplicates ;; 6. Detect TSSs using detectTSS and export them using exportTSS ;; 7. Perform differential TSS expression analysis using fitDiffTSS and detectDiffTSS
workflows.code:
idxlist <- c("CAAGTG", "TTAGCC", "GTGGAA", "TGTGAG")
dir <- system.file("extdata", package="icetea")
fnames <- c("embryo1", "embryo2", "embryo3", "embryo4")
cs <- newCapSet(expMethod = 'MAPCap',
                fastq_R1 = file.path(dir, 'mapcap_test_R1.fastq.gz'),
                fastq_R2 = file.path(dir, 'mapcap_test_R2.fastq.gz'),
                idxList = idxlist,
                sampleNames = fnames)
dir.create("splitting")
cs <- demultiplexFASTQ(cs, max_mismatch = 1, outdir = "splitting", ncores = 10)
dir.create("genome_index")
library(Rsubread)
buildindex(basename = "genome_index/dm6", reference = "/path/to/dm6/genome.fa")
subread_idx <- "genome_index/dm6"
cs <- mapCaps(cs, subread_idx, outdir = "mapping", ncores = 20, logfile = "mapping/subread_mapping.log")
dir.create("removedup")
cs <- filterDuplicates(cs, outdir = "removedup")
dir.create("tssCalling")
cs <- detectTSS(cs, groups = c("wt", "wt", "mut", "mut"),
                 outfile_prefix = "tssCalling/testTSS", restrictChr = "X", ncores = 1)
exportTSS(cs, merged = TRUE, outfile_prefix = "tssCalling/testTSS")
csfit <- fitDiffTSS(cs, groups = rep(c("wt","mut"), each = 2), normalization = "windowTMM",
                     outplots = NULL, plotref = "embryo1")
de_tss <- detectDiffTSS(csfit, testGroup = "mut", contGroup = "wt",
               TSSfile = file.path(dir, "testTSS_merged.bed"), MAplot_fdr = 0.05)

workflows.name: bam_entry_tss_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform TSS detection and analysis starting directly from pre-aligned and de-duplicated BAM files.
input: sample1.bam (Pre-aligned and de-duplicated BAM file for sample 1)
sample2.bam (Pre-aligned and de-duplicated BAM file for sample 2)
workflows.stages: 1. Create a CapSet object directly from pre-filtered BAM files using newCapSet ;; 2. Detect TSSs using detectTSS ;; 3. Export TSSs to BED format using exportTSS
workflows.code:
fnames <- c("embryo1", "embryo2", "embryo3", "embryo4")
dir <- system.file("extdata/filtered_bam", package = "icetea")
cs2 <- newCapSet(expMethod = 'MAPCap',
                 filtered_file = list.files(dir, pattern = ".bam$", full.names = TRUE),
                 sampleNames = fnames)
dir.create("tssCalling")
cs2 <- detectTSS(cs2, groups = c("wt", "wt", "mut", "mut"),
                 outfile_prefix = "tssCalling/testTSS", restrictChr = "X", ncores = 1)
exportTSS(cs2, merged = TRUE, outfile_prefix = "tssCalling/testTSS")
